content.short: The Ton Foundation is the non-profit organization dedicated to the growth and decentralization of the TON network.
content.description: The TON Foundation is an independent, non-profit organization committed to supporting the development and widespread adoption of The Open Network (TON). It manages the ecosystem's strategic growth, provides grants to developers, and works to ensure the long-term decentralization and security of the network. By fostering a vibrant community and coordinating core development efforts, the TON Foundation plays a vital role in realizing the vision of an open, high-performance blockchain capable of onboarding billions of users through seamless integration with platforms like Telegram.
content.meta: Learn about the TON Foundation and the mission to build a decentralized future on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
